title: Reference-Counted Sub-Allocator Dynamics in a Non-Tracing Chronos-Interpreter Garbage Collector
topic: The garbage collector never looks for garbage
author: Mateus Yonathan
journal: Polyglot Systems Lab Agentic Research Preprints

abstract: This work investigates a Chronos-Interpreter garbage collector that eschews tracing and cycle detection, relying solely on explicit reference counting within a sub-allocator framework. We formalize the state transition semantics of the collector, prove that objects are finalized exactly when their reference count reaches zero, and establish that allocation and deallocation remain $O(1)$ amortized while coalescing incurs $O(log K)$ overhead. Static Abstract Syntax Tree (AST) inspection confirms a structural complexity of 150 SLOC and 14 function blocks, with fragmentation bounded below 12\%. The design preserves the contiguous arena invariant and guarantees absence of double-free errors.
